挽歌嘲讽对手，增加挽歌的信心，让对手更难克服恐惧。

abilities.desc_en:
Grim Mockery
Dirge taunts his opponent, increasing Dirges' confidence and making it harder for the opponent to overcome their fear.
Passive: If the opponent misses a Melee Attack while under the effects of Fear, Dirge gains +{{var_11}} Attack for {{var_12}}. Reduces the chance to remove Fear by {{var_13}} until the next time Fear is removed. (Max Stacks: 1)
